sections.title: ROOF CURBS SET AND FIELD MEASUREMENT

photos.caption: New roof curb set at RTU-1. The roofer set the curb and temporarily dried it in so the open penetration is weather tight overnight.
Field measuring the new curb against the existing roof opening at RTU-2. The opening does not match the new curb, which drove RFI-001.
RTU-2 curb sitting out of level (RFI-001). To be leveled per the engineer's direction. Video still, 03/03/2026.
RTU-2 curb, second view showing the gap at the low corner (RFI-001). Video still, 03/03/2026.
Hand dug pothole exposing a marked underground utility before the conduit trench, to keep the trench clear of it.
Excavation at the equipment pad, ringed with safety fencing.
